name: meinbezirk.at Wien
notes: Server-rendered list at /event/wien/list/all/{page}?eventitem_filter_simple[date_start]=..&[date_end]=.. (bracket keys). No JSON-LD/API; parses <article class="content-list-item content-card ..."> blocks. Category and district come from the URL slug (/event/<district>/c-<category>/<slug>_eID); price stays null except when the teaser text explicitly says "Eintritt frei"/kostenlos (regex, no loose keyword match to avoid false positives like 'frei von...'). Record count fluctuates a bit run to run because the site's own pagination reorders/duplicates items across pages; scrape.py dedupes by event id and retries flaky page fetches.
